summary: All undergraduate and graduate new and transfer students of the College of Engineering admitted in the 2016 academic year or later are asked to complete the Fall 2026 Life-Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education. Register for and take the course on SNU eTL during either session: 24 August to 7 September 2026, or 28 October to 27 November 2026. No exceptional additional enrolment is allowed after the course periods close.
applies_to: All new and transfer (신(편)입생) students, both undergraduate and graduate, of the College of Engineering who were admitted in the 2016 academic year or later. The notice asks these students to complete the education.

dates.what: Course period, first session (register and complete the online course)
Course period, second session (register and complete the online course)

conditions: Students who do not complete the course within a course period cannot take it later as an exception.
To complete the course, you must watch at least 80% of the video lectures and then take the quiz.
steps: Read the attached plan for the Fall 2026 Life-Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education (the attachment was not read for this translation).
During one of the course periods, log in to SNU eTL and go to the Course List (강좌목록).
Register for the course "[공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육" ([College of Engineering] Life-Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education).
Watch at least 80% of the video lectures.
Issue your certificate of completion on eTL: click 'My Menu (your name)' at the top right → Non-regular courses (비정규 강좌 수강) → In progress/Ended (진행중/종료) → Issue certificate (이수증 발급).
translation:
Fall 2026 Life-Respect Education (Suicide Prevention)

The Fall 2026 Life-Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education will be conducted as follows. Students in the target group are asked to complete the education.

A. Purpose: To build a safety net through which students can protect life, based on a correct understanding of and knowledge about suicide gained through Life-Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education.

B. Target group: All new and transfer students (신(편)입생) of the College of Engineering, undergraduate and graduate, admitted in the 2016 academic year or later.

C. How to take the course: Log in to SNU eTL → Course List (강좌목록) → register for and take "[공과대학]생명존중(자살예방)교육" ([College of Engineering] Life-Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education).

D. Course periods: (Session 1) Monday 24 August 2026 – Monday 7 September 2026 / (Session 2) Wednesday 28 October 2026 – Friday 27 November 2026.
※ If you do not complete the course within a course period, no exceptional additional enrolment will be allowed.

E. Certificate of completion
1) Watch at least 80% of the video lectures, then take the quiz.
2) eTL → 'My Menu (your name)' at the top right → Non-regular courses (비정규 강좌 수강) → In progress/Ended (진행중/종료) → Issue certificate (이수증 발급).
3) Issuance: The certificate can be issued immediately upon completion.

Attachment (1): 2026년도 2학기 생명존중(자살예방)교육 계획.pdf (Fall 2026 Life-Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education Plan, 70 KB). The content of this attachment was not read.
